question: What sovereign powers does the practitioner gain after the highest repetition?
premises: The practitioner becomes both creator and destroyer.
The practitioner acts unobstructed in the world.
inference: After the highest repetition, the practitioner becomes a sovereign, unobstructed lord capable of creating and destroying in the world.
plain_english: O Gaurī, one becomes oneself a creator and destroyer, an unobstructed lord in the world.
